message.content: The image shows a pair of dual daggers titled "ADAGAS DA ZOEY" (Dual Daggers). The daggers have a sleek, crystalline design with vibrant pink and blue hues, featuring sharp, pointed blades that converge at a central, glowing light source. A golden band and a gem - like base adorn the handle, set against a dark background with soft, out - of - focus blue and purple bokeh effects, giving the weapon a magical, ethereal appearance.
